items.title: CVS says GLP-1s save money when priced below $350 per month

items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Wins Seven Stevie Awards For AI And Technology
items.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) has received seven Stevie Awards recognizing its use of artificial intelligence and technology in healthcare. The honors cover CVS Health projects in emergency response, virtual care delivery, and tools that support workforce training and development. These awards highlight how CVS Health is applying AI to practical, operational problems across its healthcare and pharmacy ecosystem.
